mentions.name: birthday_party
mentions.description: This tool computes hash collisions of truncated SHA-256 using GPU brute force, currently colliding 96-bit truncated SHA-256 in under 24 hours on a single 6700 XT. Planned work includes supporting contributions from untrusted clients to enable a crowd-sourced, SETI@home-like compute system, targeting larger collisions such as ~102-bit (feasible with rented GPU capacity) and 128-bit (optimistically possible with enough crowd-sourced compute).
mentions.source_excerpt:
I resurrected some of my old code for computing hash collisions: https://github.com/DavidBuchanan314/birthday_party (it's actually more of a rewrite)

It can collide 96-bit truncated sha256 in under 24 hours on a 6700XT.
